ui.title: Tarb Stats Server
ui.subtitle: A Time Series Store for web-archive stats on Wikipedia
ui.wiki.placeholder: e.g. en, fr, commons — blank = all
ui.uniq_caveat: Combined total of a “unique” metric is a sum of per-wiki uniques (an upper bound), not a global de-duplicated count.
desc.iabotapi: Changes made by IABot. Counts generated by the IABot stats API.
desc.iabotapi.dead_links: Links the bot found dead and rescued by inserting an archived copy.
desc.iabotapi.live_links: Still-working links the bot proactively archived, so a snapshot exists for when they later die.
desc.iabotapi.tag_links: Dead links the bot could not rescue (no archive available), so it marked them with a {{dead link}} tag.
desc.iabotapi.unknown_links: Links the bot archived but whose live-or-dead status it couldn't confirm.
desc.iabotapi.reactive_edits: Page edits that rescued at least one dead link by adding an archive. (Pairs with Dead links.)
desc.iabotapi.proactive_edits: Page edits that only added archives to still-live links — no dead links involved. (Pairs with Live links.)
desc.iabotapi.dead_edits: Page edits that only tagged dead links {{dead link}} because no archive was available. (Pairs with Tagged links.)
desc.iabotapi.unknown_edits: Page edits that fall into none of the above categories.
desc.booksup: archive.org/details links added by BooksUp website and gadget. Counts generated by the BooksUp stats API.
desc.medic_enwiki: Changes made by WaybackMedic to English Wikipedia. Counts generated by WaybackMedic logs.
desc.medic_iabotdb: Changes made by WaybackMedic in the IABot Database. Counts generated by WaybackMedic logs.
source.arcstat: Archive URLs — from live wiki pages
desc.eventstreams.iabot_wayback: Number of Wayback links added by IABot. Counts observed from the MediaWiki EventStream API have a less than 5% margin of error. For more precision see the InternetArchiveBot API results.
desc.eventstreams.user_wayback: Number of Wayback links added by human editors. Counts observed from the MediaWiki EventStream API have a less than 5% margin of error.
metric.eventstreams.otherbot_wayback: Wayback links added by User Bots
desc.eventstreams.otherbot_wayback: Number of Wayback links added by user bots — automated accounts other than IABot. Counts observed from the MediaWiki EventStream API have a less than 5% margin of error.
desc.eventstreams.iabot_details: Number of archive.org/details links for books added to Wikipedia by LAMP bot. Counts observed from the MediaWiki EventStream API have a less than 5% margin of error.
desc.eventstreams.iabot_sim: Number of archive.org/details links for journals added to Wikipedia by LAMP bot. Counts observed from the MediaWiki EventStream API have a less than 5% margin of error.
desc.eventstreams.other_details: Number of archive.org/details links for books and journals added to Wikipedia by other Editors (excludes LAMP). Counts observed from the MediaWiki EventStream API have a less than 5% margin of error.
desc.medic_enwiki.archives_added: Archive URLs added to citations (mostly Wayback).
desc.medic_enwiki.links_moved: Dead links rewritten to a new working URL (redirect/rule-mapped).
desc.medic_enwiki.status_to_live: Citations switched from url-status=dead to live ie. making pre-existing archive URLs secondary.
desc.medic_enwiki.status_to_dead: Citations switched from url-status=live to dead ie. making pre-existing archive URLs primary.
desc.medic_iabotdb.archive_add: Archive URLs added to records that previously had no archive URLs.
desc.medic_iabotdb.archive_modify: Existing archive URLs replaced with a different snapshot date.
desc.medic_iabotdb.archive_delete: Archive URLs removed from a record.
desc.medic_iabotdb.archive_unchanged: Records reviewed where the archive was left unchanged.
desc.arcstat.pages_wayback: Pages with at least one Wayback link.
desc.arcstat.altarchive_links: Alt-archive links present (not Archive.is or WebCite).
desc.arcstat.pages_altarchive: Pages with at least one alt-archive link.
desc.arcstat.pages_archiveis: Pages with at least one Archive.is link.
desc.arcstat.pages_webcite: Pages with at least one WebCite link.
desc.arcstat.googlebooks_links: Google Books links in citations (with ISBN).
desc.numberofurl.pagesurls: Pages with at least one external URL.
desc.numberofurl.uniqialiburls: Unique Internet Archive URLs (within the wiki).
desc.numberofurl.pagesialiburls: Pages with at least one Internet Archive URL.
desc.numberofurl.pageswaybackurls: Pages with at least one Wayback URL.
desc.numberofurl.pagesarchivetodayurls: Pages with at least one Archive.today URL.
desc.numberofurl.pageswebciteurls: Pages with at least one WebCite URL.
group.es_otherbot_wayback: Wayback links added by User Bots
group.es_media_users: Book & Journal links added by Users
